color.summary: ALF's light theme is white with black text, slate greys for secondary text (#405168 for handles, #667b99 for post actions) and #dce2ea for every hairline. Bluesky blue #006aff is the one accent: Follow, links and mentions. Dark mode defaults to dim, a navy theme: #151d28 pages, #1c2736 raised surfaces, #2c3a4e hairlines, #abb8c9 secondary text, links in #4d97ff and the primary at #0f73ff.
usage: Bluesky also ships an OLED dark theme on #000; new users get dim.

type.summary: InterVariable throughout: 15px on a 20px line for post text, 15px at 600 for names, 13.1px for handles, timestamps and meta, 16px on controls. Small labels drop to 11.3px.

shape.summary: Buttons are pills; cards, link previews and dialogs have 12px corners, menus and count chips 8px, menu rows 4px. Avatars are circles.

spacing.summary: ALF's space scale is small steps (2, 4, 8, 12, 16px). Small buttons are 33px with 14px padding, large 44px with 24px; post actions are 28px. Feeds pad posts 12 to 16px.

elevation.summary: Feeds are flat, split by 1px hairlines. Menus and the hover card float on 0 10px 15px -3px plus 0 4px 6px -4px in black at 10% (40% in dim); dialogs on a 0 0 30px glow.

button.summary: Most buttons on the profile are pressable toggles (Follow, Sign in, the post actions) and are in toggle-button. This grid is mostly post media, which opens a viewer.
